input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子想，难怪我们常常搬家，原来我妈妈很忙。可是常常搬家害得孟子很难找到朋友。每次搬家孟子也觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷，不是太大就是太小。在哪的地方，他都不高兴。孟子想帮助妈妈祭拜，可是他六岁，所以不能祭拜。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P79] 每次搬家孟子【也】觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷
  proposed by the correction model: 每次搬家孟子[也→都]觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧长大的时候一直搬家 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): 孟子[长大的时候→小时候]一直搬家
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card incorrect_story_information: Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. Not an error: Do not flag a word or sentence under this rule only because of grammar or vocabulary. Flag it here when it changes or adds a fact in the traditional story.

[P80] 不是【太】大就是太小
  proposed by the correction model: 不是[-太]大就是太小
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]就不会成为好的大人 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-你]就太淘气了 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): 她有一个很小的[孩子→儿子]
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P81] 不是太大就是【太】小
  proposed by the correction model: 不是太大就是[-太]小
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]就不会成为好的大人 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): 她有一个很小的[孩子→儿子]
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 可是[-他们的]收入也很低
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card incorrect_story_information: Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. Not an error: Do not flag a word or sentence under this rule only because of grammar or vocabulary. Flag it here when it changes or adds a fact in the traditional story.

[P82] 在【哪的】地方
  proposed by the AI checker: 在[哪→哪个]的地方 (“在哪个地方” is the grammatical phrase.)
  proposed by the correction model: 在[哪的→任何]地方
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 在[第三个房子→第三个地方]
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 就[在地方→在地上]躺着
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 在第一个[房子→地方]
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.

[P83] 可是他【^】六岁
  proposed by the correction model: 可是他[+只有]六岁
  her past correction (redundant_words): 他才四[-年]岁
  her past correction (adversative_connector): 他才三岁[+，可是一直]的以后待在墓地里
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 他才三岁[-的以后]待在墓地里 — her note: Time + 以后
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card adversative_connector: Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real “semantic turn,” such as a contrast or an unexpected result. 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn. Not an error: Use 却 when the result is an unexpected semantic turn.

places.reason: “也” naturally adds another difficulty of moving.
“不是太大就是太小” is a natural either-or expression.
“太小” correctly parallels “太大” in this expression.
哪的地方 is not a natural phrase here; the meaning is any place.
“他六岁” is grammatically acceptable and supports the contrast.
